items.text: On the Trades tab, in How it played out, show a trend line between 5 and 10 minutes and say whether the coin is trending up, neutral or down.
items.note: Released in 1.0.59: open any trade and the replay shows the minute 5 to 10 trend, a dotted line carrying that pace to the close, and a card with the move, pace and how steady it was. Using the trend to close a bet early is not built; that changes how trading works.

items.text: Add a daily profit lockout: stop trading once the day hits a profit target, so a good day isn't given back.
items.note: Settings, Stops: Daily profit target. Over the four months to Nov 9 a low target cost a lot of profit ($25 a day kept almost nothing), while $200 a day came out a little ahead of no target. Test it on paper before trusting it.
